_: scripts/ast-link-carrier-check.mjs (npm run verify). In-text links whose ref record does not carry the page they name while another record does, as they stood on 2026-10-16 after the package-M repair (scripts/repair-subpage-link-refs.mjs). Key: "<to>|<ref>". A pair not listed fails; more pairs than max fails; a listed pair that no longer occurs is reported, and --shrink drops it. The list only shrinks. Shrunk by --shrink after the package-I relink pass (scripts/relink-carried-pages.mjs, 2026-10-17); each remaining pair's "why" comes from PAIR_REASONS in the check.

reasons.same-name-variant: the link opens the bare-named record; the page belongs to a same-named variant record (a grade, an archetype's or class's own copy, a second printing). Whether it should open the variant is per pair: for a class page linking a shared feature the bare record is the one the player has.
reasons.several-carriers: more than one record carries the page and the link opens none of them; which one it should open is not decidable from the page id alone.
reasons.other-record: the link opens a record of another name: either the record carrying the page is a stamping oddity (a Rounds record carrying its weapon's page, a class option carrying its innovation page) or a reprint pairing the Archives state two ways (Miracle -> Wish ritual / Manifestation).
